review_method: Recovered files and five one-second sampled frames per shot; final full-frame temporal and composition review still required.

shots.observation: Green sunny countryside with drifting leaves; visually similar to spring, so the season is not independently unambiguous.
shots.use_policy: One summer cue only beside an authored Summer label and a distinct spring-to-summer transition.

shots.observation: Orange-brown foliage and falling leaves clearly communicate autumn, with no generated lettering.
shots.use_policy: One five-second autumn cue in s08.

shots.observation: Leafless tree, snow-covered ground, and falling snow clearly communicate winter, with no generated lettering.
shots.use_policy: One five-second winter cue in s08.
